lede: Texas carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.5 against +4.1, a 6.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tennessee -0.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Tennessee winning 50% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Texas leads Tennessee by 110 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.

items.label: market disagreement
items.text: The market disagrees by 5.7 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.

items.text: College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
